title: Buddy Petit at Frenchman's Hall; his looks and stepfather teacher
summary: Punch remembers Petit playing at Francs Amis for light-skinned crowds, his light brown skin, the white callus on his lip and Joe Petit teaching him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: How many guys? The Frenchman carried me to the Frenchman Hall, you know. Because the house people couldn't go down there in them guys. Right in the road.
And Frantz Amé is another one now.
All light people go there. Mm-hmm. But Buddy played so much horn, shit.
He wasn't light at all, huh?
No, Buddy was dark. Not dark as me, though.
Yeah, light brown skin. Mm-hmm. Yeah, pretty hell. Boy, he had a big old white thing there. Looked like a... It was real white. The way he blowed it.
On his bottom lip. He didn't have no corn on his top lip. On his bottom lip. Big, round, white thing. I remember him so good.
He's a real trumpet man, all right.
Were many of the guys self-taught in those days on trumpet? You know, did they start out teaching themselves, learning by themselves?
Well, from what I heard, all of them come up with somebody. All of them, yeah. Buddy didn't go in the home, I don't think, but his old stepdad showed him all that, Joe Petit.
